description: Your Philonet reading life in the terminal: feed, threads, streaks and friends, plus a local history the web app does not keep.

tools.name: blog_list
tools.description: Philonet public blog posts (no auth needed). Returns array of Blog. (public)

tools.name: feed_for_me
tools.description: Personalized 'For You' / friends feed (feed2 engine). filter=forme|friends. Optional: filter, page, pageSize. Returns array of FormeItem.

tools.name: feed_moment
tools.description: Featured 'moment' card. Returns the Moment.

tools.name: feed_suggested
tools.description: Suggested curiosity-session feed. Returns the SuggestedFeed.

tools.name: feed_unified
tools.description: Unified feed. filter=discover|friends. Optional: filter, page, pageSize. Returns array of UnifiedItem.

tools.name: find_articles
tools.description: Search articles (POST body: query, sort_by, limit, offset). Required: query. Optional: limit (default: 20), offset (default: 0), sort_by (default: relevance). Returns the new Article3.

tools.name: find_people
tools.description: Search people. Required: query. Optional: limit (default: 20), offset (default: 0). Returns the new People.

tools.name: find_thoughts
tools.description: Search thoughts/comments. Required: query. Optional: limit (default: 20), offset (default: 0), sort_by (default: relevance). Returns the new Thought.

tools.name: friends_requests
tools.description: Friend requests (type=received|sent|all). Optional: limit, offset, type. Returns the Request.

tools.name: friends_requests_preview
tools.description: Friend requests preview. Returns the FriendRequestsPreview.

tools.name: friends_respond
tools.description: Accept or decline a friend request (action=accept|decline). Required: request_id, action. Returns the updated Object.

tools.name: friends_send_request
tools.description: Send a friend request. Required: target_user_id. Returns the new Object.

tools.name: friends_stories
tools.description: Friends activity as stories. Optional: forme, unread_only. Returns the Friendsasstory.

tools.name: friends_thinking
tools.description: Friends/contacts thinking list with presence. Returns array of FriendsthinkinglistUser.

tools.name: friends_top
tools.description: Top friends. Returns the Topfriend.

tools.name: friends_withdraw
tools.description: Withdraw a sent friend request. Required: user_id. Returns the Object. Destructive.

tools.name: inbox_activity
tools.description: Notifications / activity log. Optional: limit. Returns the Activity.

tools.name: inbox_discussions
tools.description: Discussions inbox (POST, read-only). Optional: limit (default: 20), muted (default: all), offset (default: 0) (plus 2 more). Returns the new Inboxnew.

tools.name: inbox_dms
tools.description: Direct-message conversations. Optional: limit. Returns the Conversation.

tools.name: inbox_invitations
tools.description: Space invitations. Optional: page, per_page. Returns the Invitation.

tools.name: inbox_unread
tools.description: Unread counters (notifications, invitations, total). Returns the Unread.

tools.name: inbox_unread_conversations
tools.description: Unread discussion counters. Returns the Unreadconversation.

tools.name: invite_send
tools.description: Invite a user to share thoughts on an article. Required: url, title, target_user_id. Returns the new Object.

tools.name: invite_users
tools.description: Search users to invite. Required: query. Returns the new Object.

tools.name: me_awards
tools.description: Awards/stars received. Returns the Myaward.

tools.name: me_badge
tools.description: Verification / top-learner badge for a user. Optional: userId. Returns the Verificationbadge.

tools.name: me_bookmarks
tools.description: Bookmarked thoughts. Returns the Mybookmark.

tools.name: me_engagements
tools.description: My engagements. Returns the Myengagement.

tools.name: me_metrics
tools.description: My verified categories, stars, streak. Returns the Metric.

tools.name: me_onboarding
tools.description: Onboarding state and interests. Returns the Onboarding.

tools.name: me_profile
tools.description: Full profile for a user (POST, read-only). Optional: userId. Returns the new Mainprofilenew.

tools.name: me_profile_stats
tools.description: Streak and reading totals for a user. Optional: userId. Returns the Myprofilestat.

tools.name: me_read_later
tools.description: Read-later saved articles. Returns the Readlater.

tools.name: me_reading_stats
tools.description: My reading stats: last 7 days, goals, personal bests. Returns the Stat.

tools.name: me_spotlights
tools.description: Spotlights. Returns the Spotlightsnew.

tools.name: me_standings
tools.description: Friends thinking-time leaderboard. Returns the Friendsstanding.

tools.name: me_thoughts
tools.description: A user's thoughts (paged). Optional: limit, page. Returns the Conversationsnew.

tools.name: post_link
tools.description: Add a link as an article so you can post a thought on it. Required: url, title, description. Returns the new Object.

tools.name: post_reply
tools.description: Reply to a thought. Required: parentCommentId, content. Returns the new Object.

tools.name: post_thought
tools.description: Post a thought (comment) on an article by article id. Required: articleId, content. Returns the new Object.

tools.name: react_bookmark
tools.description: Toggle bookmark on a thought. Required: comment_id. Returns the new Object.

tools.name: react_star
tools.description: Star a thought. Required: comment_id. Returns the new Object.

tools.name: thread_article
tools.description: Get article detail, members and people (POST, read-only). Required: articleId. Returns array of ArticlePeople.

tools.name: thread_get
tools.description: Get one thought (comment) with article context and star quota. Required: article_id, comment_id. Returns the Comment.

tools.name: thread_impact
tools.description: Reader impact stats for an article. Required: article_id. Returns the Impact.

tools.name: thread_replies
tools.description: List replies in a thought thread (POST, read-only). Required: articleId, parentCommentId. Optional: includeParentDetails (default: true), jump_to_latest (default: true), limit (default: 20). Returns the new Room.

novel_features.name: Today briefing
novel_features.description: One snapshot of your streak, reading time, friends thinking now, unread counts and pending requests.

novel_features.name: Reading rhythm
novel_features.description: Weekly and monthly reading minutes, longest streak and rank-vs-friends trend, accumulated from your own runs (history starts at the first run).

novel_features.name: Friends digest
novel_features.description: Friends' thoughts this CLI first saw recently, grouped by friend; 'recently' is relative to when the CLI saw them.

novel_features.name: Owed replies
novel_features.description: Threads among your recent thoughts where someone replied and you have not answered yet.

novel_features.name: Voices
novel_features.description: Rank people from your stored For You feed cards by thoughts on a topic, filtered by alma mater or employer badge.

novel_features.name: Reading queue
novel_features.description: Read-later and bookmarks that fit your free minutes (items with unknown length are dropped unless --include-unknown), flagged when discussed.

novel_features.name: Resonance
novel_features.description: Which of your thoughts earned stars and insightful reactions, by tag and week.
